title: feat(embedder-openai): an over-limit input is refused, not truncated (known-model input limits, one shared token estimate)
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpEsWWE9Y5YtSsDgqZ
Fixes #37093

Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 用户能看到什么变化：接 OpenAI 兼容嵌入服务的应用，文本超过模型输入上限时会直接报错（写明第几条、模型、估算长度和上限），不再被服务商悄悄截断。
- 为什么做：属于「知识检索平台化」专题，解决长文本后半段搜不到却没有任何提示的问题。
- 出错会怎样：估算偏保守，接近上限的文本可能被多拒一些（可通过配置项放宽）；几乎全是 UUID、哈希、base64 的文本仍可能估少，按你「C 照现在合入」的裁决只写明、不另修。直接撤回本改动也安全。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

Opened by the seat session on the maintainer's authorization (「#37093：开 PR 放行。你应该使用 pm-dispatch 技能审核和落地pr，该放行的都放行」); the developer's own `pr_create` in its session (`session_01QSeKYpJCg2rG1RGK4BwAKx`) was refused by a permission check. Body below is the developer's, verbatim apart from this paragraph and the formula notes in Acceptance notes.

1. **Known-model input limits** — `packages/plugins/embedder-openai/src/index.ts` gains `KNOWN_MAX_INPUT_TOKENS`; `OpenAIEmbedderOptions.maxInputTokens?` (positive integer) overrides it.
2. **Refused, not truncated** — When a limit applies (a known model, or `maxInputTokens`), `embed()` measures every input before any request; an unknown model with no `maxInputTokens` is not measured. An input whose estimate is over the limit fails the whole call with an error naming its 0-based index, the model, the estimate and the limit, and telling the caller to split the text; nothing is sent. An input at or under the limit is sent unchanged.
3. **Unknown model, no option** — no limit, one warning per embedder instance, folded into the existing batch-size warning; the warning names which table the model is missing from (batch-size, input-limit, or both).
4. **One shared estimate** — module `packages/spec/src/shared/token-estimate.ts`, exported on `@objectstack/spec/shared` as `estimateTokens(text)` plus `TOKEN_ESTIMATE_MARGIN` (1.1) and `ASCII_RUN_CHARS_PER_TOKEN` (`{ letters: 4, digits: 3, mixed: 2 }`). Formula (ruling 「C」, comment 7150730452, refining ruling 「A」, comment 7149124439): CJK characters and full-width punctuation 1.5 each; an ASCII run counted by what it holds — letters only ceil(n/4), digits only ceil(n/3), letters and digits mixed ceil(n/2); other punctuation 1; whitespace 0; any other non-whitespace character 1; × 1.1, rounded up. Whitespace is tested first, so the ideographic space U+3000 counts 0. Both constants are typed `number` (frozen, read-only). Documented on the docblock and in `content/docs/ai/knowledge-rag.mdx` ("Embedder input limits"); both state the known residual (random hex / base64 can still estimate below cl100k).
5. `IEmbedder` is not changed.

### Why the estimate lives in `@objectstack/spec`

`embedder-openai`'s only dependency is `@objectstack/spec`; `service-knowledge` depends on `core`, `service-settings` and `spec`. The intersection is `spec` alone. `spec/shared` already exports pure runtime helpers of the same class (`resilientFetch`, used by `embedder-openai`; `currencyForLocale`). A pure, dependency-free text measure is in that class — no policy, no I/O, no state.

### Input limits — provider sources (read 2026-11-24)

| Model | Limit | Source |
|:---|---:|:---|
| `text-embedding-3-small`, `-3-large`, `-ada-002` | 8192 | OpenAI embeddings API reference ("8192 tokens for all embedding models") |
| `text-embedding-v3` | 8192 | Alibaba Model Studio text-embedding API |
| `text-embedding-v2`, `-v1` | 2048 | same page |
| `embedding-3` | 3072 | BigModel embeddings API reference |
| `embedding-2` | 512 | same page |
| `BAAI/bge-m3` | 8192 | SiliconFlow embeddings API reference |
| `BAAI/bge-large-zh-v1.5`, `-en-v1.5` | 512 | same page |

Not documented, so left out (no limit, warning): `doubao-embedding-*`, `nomic-embed-text`, `embo-01`, Ollama `bge-m3`, `BAAI/bge-base-zh-v1.5`, `BAAI/bge-small-zh-v1.5`.

## Tests

- `packages/spec/src/shared/token-estimate.test.ts` — the formula term by term, including one case per ASCII run class. The cl100k acceptance test asserts `estimateTokens(text) >= cl100k` against recorded fixtures, sampled with `js-tiktoken` 1.0.21 outside the repo (no dependency added). The fixtures are 5 Chinese regulation-like samples, 5 mixed Chinese/English samples and 10 English-heavy samples (long words, SQL identifiers, code, URL, numbers, 12- and 8-digit runs, prose, a 16–20 digit run sample, a URL carrying a 32-hex id), plus U+3000 alone and inside Chinese text; 29 cases in total.
- `packages/plugins/embedder-openai/src/__tests__/openai-embedder.test.ts` — "input limit (refused, not truncated)": over-limit refused naming index/model/estimate/limit and telling the caller to split the text (the "Split the text below the limit" wording is pinned), with fetch never called; at-limit sent unchanged; per-model limits; explicit `maxInputTokens` wins; non-positive-integer option refused; unknown model → no limit, one warning; every row of `KNOWN_MAX_INPUT_TOKENS` pinned table-driven (at the limit sent, just over refused naming that limit); the warning names the table a model is missing from (`embedding-2`: batch-size only; an unknown model: both); 29 cases in total.

Local readings at head `8007e0bf`:
- spec `token-estimate.test.ts` 29 passed; embedder-openai 29 passed; typecheck 0 on both.
- `check:generated`: 14/14 up to date.
- 13 derived gates all exit 0; `overlap-check` clean.
- Ablations, each restored with blob == HEAD:
  - Refusal disabled → the input-limit tests red.
  - Per class, ruling C: digits set back to 4 → `en-digits-20` red; mixed set back to 4 → `en-url-hex-id` red; the letters class is already ceil(n/4), so it has no own pin.
  - U+3000 let past the whitespace test again → the ideographic-space case red (1 failed / 28 passed); restored, blob == HEAD.
- Full spec suite last run at `2724c5e4` (984 files / 29879 passed); only `token-estimate.ts` / its test changed under `spec/src` since, and CI runs the full suite at head.

## Acceptance notes

- Deviation: `pr_create` refused in the dev session; opened by the seat session on the maintainer's authorization. This body update was likewise handed to the seat rather than sent from the dev session's relay.
- **Formula ruling C applied** (record 7150730452 on #37093, the maintainer: 「C」), refining ruling A (record 7149124439). An ASCII run is counted by class, so long numbers and hex-carrying URLs err high too. The cost the ruling accepts is over-estimating plain alphanumeric codes by up to about 2×.
- Measured residual under C, not pinned: text made mostly of random hex or base64 still estimates below cl100k — a UUID 28 vs 40, sha256 hex plus base64 71 vs 81. cl100k splits random hex at about one character per token and base64 at about 1.4, below the mixed class's 2. The docs state this limit. The maintainer ruled 「C 照现在合入（推荐）」 (record 7151457223 on #37093): the residual stays documented (docblock and `knowledge-rag.mdx`) and unpinned, with no follow-up card until real use embeds hash- or UUID-dense text.
- The estimate errs high (about 1.4× cl100k on Chinese text), so an input whose real count is under the limit can be refused too — e.g. on a 512-token BGE model about 311–510 Chinese characters (counted at about one token per character on BGE: 310 characters estimate 512 and are sent, 311 estimate 514 and are refused, 510 estimate 842); the changeset says so, with both remedies (split smaller, or set `maxInputTokens`).
- `IEmbedder.maxInputTokens?` / the service learning the limit (#37098) and `IEmbedder.model?` (#37100) are out of scope.
- The merged unknown-model warning: an app that set only `maxBatchSize` for an unknown model now warns again (stated in the changeset).

## Verification

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/embedder-openai test` — the eight "input limit" cases pass.
